edges: Eli and Solara investigate an isolated house and fall into a trap.
Carnegie threatens to kill Solara unless Eli surrenders the Bible.
Carnegie shoots Eli, leaving him for dead.
Eli and Solara reach Alcatraz Island after driving.
Eli reveals to the guards that he has a copy of the King James Version of the Bible.
Eli warns Solara about impending danger.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Solara escapes and drives back to help Eli.

edges: Eli navigates through a post-apocalyptic world full of unseen dangers.
Eli treasures every word of the book he carries.
